propos: Two embedded families: Sora for titles and meaningful figures, Manrope for everything else.
echelle-propos: Each step carries its family, size, line height and weight, as the mock-up shows them.
regle-13: Below 13 px, only the tab label (12), “NOW” (12, capitals) and the “EN” tag or tick (11).

usage.22: Secondary screen title, next to back
usage.16: Row title; in Sora, block title (“The day’s thread”)
usage.15: Body text, button; in Sora, timeline hour

graisses-propos: Five weights; an accent, attention or alert fill always carries its text in 800.
italique-regle: Italics are reserved for English terms within French text. Neither Sora nor Manrope draws one: the browser slants the roman.
lettres: What the font must be able to draw
lettres-propos: The œ ligature, accented capitals and French quotation marks exist in both families, embedded in Latin and Latin Extended.
phrase: « Au nom de ma délégation », l'œuvre d'Aïssatou à la CdP31 — ÉTAT DES LIEUX, ÎLE MAURICE, CÔTE D'IVOIRE.
lettres-note: Capital I, lowercase l and the figure 1 are told apart, as are O and 0: a room and a time are never read twice.
chiffres-propos: Figures stay proportional, as in the mock-up.
chiffres-note: In tabular mode, Manrope gives the 1 the width of the other digits: “11:00” reads “1 1:00” and “COP31” “COP3 1”. The mock-up uses none.
lecture-propos: The three steps of the “Aa” setting, applied to the body of a document.
